task_title: install-hermes.sh: the occupied-port branch must not certify an unauthenticated public bind
task_criteria: 1. scripts/harness/install-hermes.sh occupied-port branch no longer prints ok port + PASS and HERMES: PASS on a config with no dashboard.basic_auth: it prints the existing auth refusal or a NAMED row stating the listener was not started by this adapter and its auth is unverified, and exits nonzero. 2. tests/selftest.sh gains an arm that drives the occupied-port branch with a listener stub and a no-basic_auth config, asserting the named FAIL row and rejecting the decoy substring; its red proof on the pre-fix tree and green proof on the fixed tree are both printed in the tick evidence. 3. The two existing green paths stay green in the same run: free port + valid basic_auth reaches PASS gateway_start, free port + no basic_auth prints the exact CF-071 refusal wording. 4. bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS and bash scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK at the landing commit. 5. docs/handbook/chapters/M5-harness.md records the new occupied-port behaviour (this row changes M5's install layer).
